notes: Faster team: up to 4 agents at once, and agents that write different files work at the same time; the extra double check runs only in the first round. Every agent gets the skills that fit its position. Agents on Codex run without your own Codex plugins (no more Chrome crash dialogs). The time estimate counts only working time, a quiet model shows 'thinking', and Fable credit errors no longer appear as the boss's message.
